summary: Meta's Alexandr Wang states that muse spark 1.2, a multimodal model, can perform visual coding, robotics planning, and audio-visual understanding via agentic tools.

practices.reason: The post claims new multimodal capabilities (visual coding, robotics planning, audio-visual understanding) but gives no benchmark or quantitative evidence to act on.
practices.quote: muse spark 1.2 is a very strong multimodal model—it can do visual coding, robotics planning, and audio-visual understanding that all come together through agentic tools.
